notes: No checked name overclaims. Most give the condition and the expected result, and the bodies assert exactly that, e.g. test_format_utc_writes_six_fractional_digits_and_z and test_reprinting_history_in_a_new_process_gives_identical_bytes (byte comparison). Two names are vague: test_valid_value_lets_the_command_run and test_unset_variable_lets_the_command_run (tests/test_cli_actor.py:163,175) only say 'runs' while their bodies assert the exact exit code, stdout and stderr, so these names say less than the bodies check.
